migrations.changes: The first DRBR save profile. Nothing to move.

rules: A migration runs at PLAY, in DRBR Launcher (SaveProfile.Migrate), from the installed profile's migration_version up to this release's.
It may change only DRBR's own folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DRBR) and the DRBR saves (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DELTARUNE\drbr_profile).
It never changes the player's own DELTARUNE saves or the mod's settings files (knight_hub.ini, knightfights_online.ini, keyconfig_mod.ini).
It moves files aside to %LOCALAPPDATA%\DRBR\backups instead of deleting them.
A profile from a newer DRBR (a higher schema_version) is refused with a message to update.
